summary: Completed iteration 3 backend regression and focused marketplace UI testing. Seller product/rental tabs and submissions, admin queue access, Google demo login, catalog/search, and mobile rendering passed.
action_items: Load frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest; the first run failed only because the test process had no BASE_URL environment variable.
critical_code_review_comments: Google login and checkout are MOCKED by design and do not represent production OAuth/payment integrations.
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=False; this is acceptable for current bearer-token storage but must be revisited if httpOnly cookie auth is introduced.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ records through existing regression tests and one temporary seller UI account/listings; no seeded records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 covers public catalog/search, admin login/me and queue APIs, seller product/rental submissions, buyer authorization, mock order, Google demo login, admin dashboard access, and mobile seller flow. Checkout and Google remain MOCKED.
rca of the issue: The initial pytest invocation reported 4 failures because BASE_URL is read from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL but the shell did not load frontend/.env; rerunning with that variable exported produced 4/4 passes. Earlier supervisor logs contain Google 422 requests, but the current UI demo flow sends the required email/name payload and passed without errors.
